summary: Numazu, Japan, computer engineer, strong interest in microkernel architecture and operating systems, advocates for open-source software, passionate about retro computing (especially Amiga), critical of mainstream tech companies (especially Intel and NVIDIA), supports decentralized communication platforms (e.g., Tox), believes in mandatory parental leave for equality, skeptical of government surveillance, identifies as an introvert, prefers low-population areas for personal space, critical of capitalism's impact on society, supports RISC-V architecture, engaged in discussions about personal finance and frugality, enjoys listening to music (especially metal) while working, has a strong preference for Linux-based operating systems (particularly Arch Linux), and has a history of using and promoting open-source tools and projects.
